title: RELATEDTABLE ( T ) and CALCULATETABLE ( T ) give the same rows in a row context
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Related", SUMX ( RELATEDTABLE ( Sales ), Sales[Amount] ), "Calculated", SUMX ( CALCULATETABLE ( Sales ), Sales[Amount] ) )

source.quote: RELATEDTABLE is an alias for CALCULATETABLE
source.supports: RELATEDTABLE is an alias for CALCULATETABLE

source.quote: This function is a shortcut for CALCULATETABLE function with no logical expression
The RELATEDTABLE function performs a context transition from row context(s) to a filter context

derivation: Context transition filters Sales to the current product. Bike: rows 1, 5, 7 = 100 + 200 + 100 = 400. Helmet: rows 2, 3 = 40 + 20 = 60. Lock: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. Scooter: no rows, SUMX over an empty table is BLANK.
